summary: Updates the Teredo IPv6-over-IPv4 tunneling protocol by changing how the flags field embedded in every Teredo address is used. The changes improve security while staying backward compatible with existing implementations.

eli5.summary: Teredo addresses carry a little set of switches. This document changes how those switches are used so that outsiders find it harder to misuse them, while old equipment still works.

questions: how to make teredo more secure
